name: Bias {biAs+} Azakeru Koe ga Kikoeru
original_name: バイアス {biAs+}嗤笑ける幻音が聴こえる
source:
The main character suffers from nightmares of unknown cause about insults. He stays awake to avoid them and consequently becomes paranoid. As time goes on, girls in contact with him start to see these devilish nightmares as well...

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
